title.zh: 将南哥打巴托省 Surallah 市镇 Lamsugod 描笼涯的 Lamian 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Lamsugod 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Lamian National High School - Lamsugod Annex in Barangay Lamsugod, Municipality of Surallah, Province of South Cotabato From the Lamian National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Lamsugod National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Lamsugod của Trường Trung học Lamian Quốc gia tại Barangay Lamsugod, Đô thị Surallah, Tỉnh South Cotabato khỏi Trường Trung học Lamian Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Lamsugod Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Lamsugod ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Lamian แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Lamsugod เทศบาล Surallah จังหวัด South Cotabato ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Lamian แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Lamsugod แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Lamsugod, Sekolah Menengah Lamian Nasional di Barangay Lamsugod, Kotamadya Surallah, Provinsi South Cotabato dari Sekolah Menengah Lamian Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Lamsugod Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Lamsugod, Sekolah Menengah Lamian Kebangsaan di Barangay Lamsugod, Perbandaran Surallah, Wilayah South Cotabato daripada Sekolah Menengah Lamian Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Lamsugod Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. – The Lamian National High School – Lamsugod Annex in Barangay Lamsugod, Municipality of Surallah, Province of South Cotabato is hereby separated from the Lamian National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Lamsugod National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. – All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Lamian National High School – Lamsugod Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Lamsugod National High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Lamsugod National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriations of the Lamian National High School – Lamsugod Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
